info.title: GATEWAY-apiwizdoc-List Airline Flights Baggages-v4-spec
info.description: The Airline Flights Baggage Listing API provides a comprehensive overview of baggage related to specific airline flights. This service enables users to retrieve detailed information about baggage allowances, restrictions, and current status associated with various flight itineraries. Typical consumers include airline staff, travelers seeking baggage details for their flights, and travel agencies managing client bookings. This API ensures that users can efficiently access essential baggage information to facilitate better travel planning and enhance the overall passenger experience.

get.description: This endpoint allows you to access comprehensive baggage details associated with various flights, ensuring you have the most accurate information regarding baggage allowances, restrictions, and any additional fees.

requestBody.description: Request body for retrieving baggage information related to flights. This body should contain the necessary data required to process the baggage query.

200.description: Request completed successfully and baggage details retrieved.
